title: Home Sensor
description: Data payload for msg_type 'sensor'. Carries a Home Assistant sensor entity state snapshot, including state value, unit, device class, and arbitrary attributes.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable display name for the entity.

state.description: Current state value as a string (e.g. '21.5', 'on', 'unavailable').

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. '°C', 'W', '%'). Null if not applicable.

device_class.description: Home Assistant device class (e.g. 'temperature', 'humidity', 'power'). Null if not set.

attributes.description: Additional entity attributes as reported by Home Assistant.
